notes: «أنه رأى مالك بن الحويرث إذا صلى» describes Malik's action; «وحدث أن رسول الله ... كان يفعل هكذا» has no clear subject: Abu Qilaba or Malik may be the one who relates it, so Malik is not added (rule 6) and the chain ends at Abu Qilaba
The «عن خالد» link is the second «خالد», distinct from «خالد بن عبد الله» as the text writes them

«أنه رأى مالك بن الحويرث إذا صلى» describes Malik's action; «وحدث أن رسول الله ... كان يفعل هكذا» has no clear subject: Abu Qilaba or Malik may be the one who relates it, so Malik is not added (rule 6) and the chain ends at Abu Qilaba
The «عن خالد» link is the second «خالد», distinct from «خالد بن عبد الله» as the text writes them
«خالد بن عبد الله» and the bare «خالد» are two men in the text: not merged (rule 9)

Malik b. al-Huwayrith is named in the scene («أنه رأى مالك بن الحويرث» describes his action) and in «وحدث أن رسول الله»: whether he is the one whose words are relayed is not settled, so he is not added
the chain ends at Abu Qilaba; the Prophet is the end
